coverage.reasoning: The claimant has submitted an itemised bill and ID proof, but explicitly states that the discharge summary will follow. According to policy condition HLTH-CON-5.2, claims must be supported by the original discharge summary and itemised hospital bill. Since the discharge summary is currently missing, the claim requires human review until all necessary documentation is provided.
